title: Pagasa raises Signal No. 2 in Batanes as Super Typhoon Rosal moves away

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal (TCWS) No. 2 was raised over Batanes as Super Typhoon Rosal (international name: Champi) moved east of northern Luzon on Wednesday morning, according to the state weather bureau. In its 11 a.m. bulletin on Wednesday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), the center of Rosal was last located 845 kilometers east of Northern Luzon as of 10 a.m. It maintained its strength as it was still carrying a maximum wind speed of 215 kilometers per hour (kph) and gustiness of up to 265 kph.
